mapper.sql: select t.todo_id, t.business_key, t.todo_title, t.apply_id, t.todo_text, t.todo_applicant, t.todo_url, t.todo_handler, t.todo_handler_name, t.todo_tp_name, t.todo_tp_link, t.create_time,t.CREATE_BY, t.modify_time, t.todo_type, t.todo_data_type, t.push_status,t.pc_url,t.real_deal_user,t.real_deal_user_name,u.nick_name as todoApplicantName,t.task_id from todo_info t left join sys_user u on t.todo_applicant = u.user_name

select todo_id, business_key, todo_title, apply_id, todo_text, todo_applicant, todo_url, todo_handler, todo_handler_name, todo_tp_name, todo_tp_link, create_time,CREATE_BY, modify_time, todo_type,pc_url,real_deal_user,real_deal_user_name, todo_data_type, push_status,B.IMG_PATH from todo_info A,wx_portal_apply_info B
mapper.select:
SELECT `pf`.`NAME_` AS `todo_tp_name`, `pf`.`KEY_` AS `PROCESS_KEY`, `p`.`BUSINESS_KEY_` AS `business_key`, `p`.`PROC_INST_ID_` AS `PROC_INST_ID`, `p`.`START_TIME_` AS `PROC_START_TIME`, `p`.`START_USER_ID_` AS `PROC_START_USER_ID`, `task`.`NAME_` AS `todo_tp_link`, `task`.`ASSIGNEE_` AS `ASSIGNEE`, `task`.`TASK_DEF_KEY_` AS `TASK_DEF_KEY`, `task`.`START_TIME_` AS `create_time`, `task`.`CLAIM_TIME_` AS `TASK_CLAIM_TIME`, `task`.`END_TIME_` AS `modify_time`, `task`.`DELETE_REASON_` AS `todo_type`, `task`.`ID_` AS `todo_id`, `task`.`DURATION_` AS `DURATION_`, `t`.`todo_title` AS `todo_title`, `t`.`todo_text` AS `todo_text`, `t`.`todo_data_type` AS `todo_data_type`, `t`.`todo_applicant` AS `todo_applicant`, `u`.`nick_name` AS `todo_handler_name`, `t`.`todo_url` AS `todo_url`, `t`.`apply_id` AS `apply_id`, (SELECT `var`.`TEXT_` FROM `act_hi_varinst` `var` WHERE ((`var`.`PROC_INST_ID_` = `p`.`PROC_INST_ID_`) AND (`var`.`NAME_` = 'nextDealUser') AND (`var`.`TASK_ID_` = `task`.`ID_`))) AS `nextDealUser`, (SELECT `var`.`TEXT_` FROM `act_hi_varinst` `var` WHERE ((`var`.`PROC_INST_ID_` = `p`.`PROC_INST_ID_`) AND (`var`.`TASK_ID_` = `task`.`ID_`) AND (`var`.`NAME_` = 'option') )) AS `option`, `u`.`user_name` AS `user_name`, `t`.`todo_handler` AS `todo_handler`, (SELECT CONCAT(( SELECT CONFIG_VALUE FROM SYS_CONFIG C WHERE C.`config_key`='S3'),`f`.`IMG_PATH`) FROM `wx_portal_apply_info` `f` WHERE (`f`.`ID` = `t`.`apply_id`)) AS `IMG_PATH` FROM todo_info T ,act_hi_taskinst task,sys_user u , act_re_procdef pf,act_hi_procinst P WHERE T.task_id=task.ID_ AND pf.ID_ = p.PROC_DEF_ID_ AND task.PROC_INST_ID_ = p.PROC_INST_ID_ AND u.`user_name`=t.`todo_applicant` and business_key = #{businessKey}
and
T.apply_id =#{item}
and t.todo_title like concat('%', #{todoTitle}, '%')
and t.todo_text = #{todoText} and t.todo_applicant = #{todoApplicant} and t.todo_url = #{todoUrl} and t.todo_handler=#{todoHandler} and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{todoHandlerName}, '%')
and (t.todo_applicant like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%') OR t.todo_handler_name like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%') OR t.todo_title like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%') OR t.todo_text like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%'))
and task.delete_reason_ = #{todoType} and task.delete_reason_ is null and task.delete_reason_ is null
ORDER BY create_time desc

SELECT distinct `t`.`apply_id`, s.APPLY_NAME AS apply_name FROM todo_info T, act_hi_taskinst task, sys_user u, act_re_procdef pf, act_hi_procinst P , wx_portal_apply_info s WHERE T.task_id = task.ID_ AND pf.ID_ = p.PROC_DEF_ID_ AND task.PROC_INST_ID_ = p.PROC_INST_ID_ AND u.`user_name` = t.`todo_applicant` AND s.ID=T.apply_id and business_key = #{businessKey} and t.todo_title like concat('%', #{todoTitle}, '%')
and t.todo_text = #{todoText} and t.todo_applicant = #{todoApplicant} and t.todo_url = #{todoUrl} and t.todo_handler=#{todoHandler} and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{todoHandlerName}, '%')
and (t.todo_applicant like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%') OR t.todo_handler_name like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%') OR t.todo_title like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%') OR t.todo_text like concat('%', #{todoInfoOrS}, '%'))
t.apply_id =#{item}
and task.delete_reason_ = #{todoType} and task.delete_reason_ is null and task.delete_reason_ is null

SELECT T.`NAME_` AS currentStepName, T.`ASSIGNEE_` AS assignee, T.`START_TIME_` AS startTime, T.`DURATION_` doration, T.`DELETE_REASON_` deleteReason, R.NAME_ AS processName, (SELECT tt.assignee_ FROM act_hi_taskinst tt WHERE tt.proc_inst_id_ = t.`PROC_INST_ID_` AND tt.id_ < t.`ID_` ORDER BY tt.id_ DESC LIMIT 1) AS preLoginId, (SELECT tt.NAME_ FROM act_hi_taskinst tt WHERE tt.proc_inst_id_ = t.`PROC_INST_ID_` AND tt.id_ < t.`ID_` ORDER BY tt.id_ DESC LIMIT 1) AS preStepName FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST T, act_re_procdef R WHERE R.ID_ = T.PROC_DEF_ID_ AND T.`ID_` = #{taskId} ;
